sections.lever checks:
- Family and target: h10 (notes/hooks.md, round 2), proposed by an independent question-author agent (B, 2026-10-10) after q01's family was retired (Easy, Too hard, Easy). Medium target, hard welcome (no Easy slot). No platform result yet.
- Dependency plan: Doc 2 L21/L77-82 (five (ii) additions incl. the Industry Group), L119 (its copper activity), L203 (Ashele already on the November 25, 2024 (ii) list, not among the five); Doc 4 L80 (as of January 15, 2025; supersedes November 25), L84/L106/L119 (Ashele and Zijin among the thirty-five (v) additions), L171 (Ashele copper), L197 (Zijin copper); Doc 6 L76 (as of August 3, 2026; supersedes January 15, 2025), L21 (forty-three new entities), L92/L120 (Baiyin pair added), L135 (Baiyin pair sources copper).
- Universe: every addition of the three updates (Doc 2's 30, Doc 4's 39, Doc 6's 45 sub-list placements). "copper" occurs in an addition's description only at Doc 2 L119 (Industry Group), Doc 4 L171 (Ashele), L197 (Zijin Mining) and Doc 6 L135 (Baiyin pair) (caller's grep of all seven texts, 2026-10-10; author B's script count: D02 3, D04 12, D06 5 occurrences incl. list names). Of these, only Ashele was already on the list (script, round 1: the only already-listed additions are Daqo, Aksu Huafu and Ashele). Entities first placed in the window = the 29 + 37 + 43 new entities; their descriptions are all in Docs 2, 4 and 6.
- Necessity: Doc 2 -> the Industry Group's copper activity and November 25, 2024 addition; Docs 4 and 6 print only its name (D04 L245, D06 L225), so without Doc 2 the member is lost or its window placement unknown. Doc 4 -> Zijin Mining's copper activity; Doc 6 prints only the name (L391). Stated risk: Zijin's copper mining is public knowledge, and its January 2025 placement can be rebuilt from Doc 2's and Doc 6's lists, so a solver without Doc 4 could reach Zijin by recall; it would also have to judge Xinjiang Zijin Nonferrous Metals (refined zinc, stated only in Doc 4) out. Doc 6 -> both Baiyin entities, post-cutoff, no substitute. The Ashele exclusion needs Doc 2's list or Doc 4's own (ii) list (L243), so no necessity claim rests on it.
- Selected-lever checks: Match, then exclude: without the "first placed" condition the answer has five names (Ashele added). Scatter the pieces: one qualifying set per notice (Doc 2: 1, Doc 4: 1, Doc 6: 2). Omission route: the parent Baiyin Nonferrous alone gives three names.
- Targeted failure modes: mode 1 (Out-of-range period, Uses the wrong period or date): Ashele, a Doc 4 (v) addition described as a copper miner, taken as first placed in January 2025 -> five names (gold plus Xinjiang Habahe Ashele Copper). Its first placement predates November 25, 2024: it is on Doc 2's (ii) list (L203) and not among that update's five additions (L78-82). Considered and not declared: the Baiyin subsidiary omission (three names), Xinjiang Zijin Nonferrous taken for a copper producer by name, and the Industry Group dropped as East Hope's removed alias; each is plausible but not a measured route.
- Calculation verification: not applicable (set). Totals cross-check: 107 + (3 + 35 + 1) = 146 against Doc 4's printed 144, a gap of two that matches Aksu Huafu and Ashele.
- Semantic/ID/overview probes: no passage groups copper entities or flags Ashele's earlier listing; the page overview names Doc 2's Industry Group and Doc 4's Zijin Mining among "Names" but gives no metals. A search for "copper" returns all five candidates plus Ashele's list entries in Docs 2, 4 and 6; the shortest valid route is to check each candidate's first placement.
- Precision/readings: "first placed on the UFLPA Entity List" is the consolidated register (Doc 2 L21: "a consolidated register of the four lists"), so a second sub-list placement is not a first placement. "from November 25, 2024 through August 3, 2026" includes both end updates. "mine, process or source copper" covers the Industry Group ("mines, smelts, and processes ... copper"), Zijin ("exploration and extraction of metals, including ... copper") and the Baiyin pair ("sourcing copper"). The alias "Xinjiang Nonferrous" that Doc 2 removes from East Hope's (i) entry (L163) is not said to be the Industry Group, which Doc 2 adds as a new entity, so the Industry Group was first placed on November 25, 2024. Names are given without "Co., Ltd." so the list separators stay unambiguous.
- Completeness: full corpus, no gaps (notes/intake.json).
- Style/set review: 26 words, no em-dash. The answer is a four-item list without a stated count (the form's List contract advisory); stating "four" would tell a solver with five copper candidates to drop one, so it is left out. q01 (dropped) shared none of these members; its Daqo step is not used. Held sibling h11 shares the Ashele step and must not go with q02.
- Warnings answered: pending the floor.

sections.question: In any order, which entities first placed on the UFLPA Entity List from November 25, 2024 through August 3, 2026 mine, process or source copper?
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Source input (Doc 2, summary and appendix 1): the update that publishes the UFLPA Entity List as of November 25, 2024 adds five entities to the section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii) list, one of them Xinjiang Nonferrous Metals Industry Group Co., Ltd., so that company was first placed on the list on November 25, 2024.

Step 2. Source input (Doc 2, description of Xinjiang Nonferrous Metals Industry Group): the company "mines, smelts, and processes raw metallic materials, including copper", so it qualifies.

Step 3. Source input (Doc 2, the section 2(d)(2)(B)(ii) list as of November 25, 2024): Xinjiang Habahe Ashele Copper Co., Ltd. is already on that list but is not one of the update's five additions, so it was first placed on the list before November 25, 2024.

Step 4. Source input (Doc 4, appendix 1): the update that publishes the list as of January 15, 2025, superseding the November 25, 2024 list, adds thirty-five entities to the section 2(d)(2)(B)(v) list, among them Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. and Xinjiang Habahe Ashele Copper Co., Ltd.

Step 5. Source input (Doc 4, descriptions): Zijin Mining Group is "principally engaged in the exploration and extraction of metals, including zinc, copper", and it is on no earlier list, so it was first placed on January 15, 2025 and qualifies. Ashele is "principally engaged in mining and producing copper, zinc, and silver", but its January 15, 2025 placement put an entity already on the list onto a second sub-list, so it is excluded.

Step 6. Source input (Doc 6, appendix 1 and the Baiyin paragraph): the update that publishes the list as of August 3, 2026, superseding the January 15, 2025 list, adds forty-three new entities, among them Baiyin Nonferrous Group Co., Ltd. and its wholly-owned subsidiary Xinjiang Baiyin Mining Development Co., Ltd., and "Baiyin Nonferrous and Xinjiang Baiyin are sourcing copper and molybdenum from the XUAR", so both qualify.

Step 7. Completeness (Doc 2, Doc 4 and Doc 6): no other description of an entity these three updates add mentions copper. Xinjiang Zijin Nonferrous Metals Co., Ltd. produces refined zinc, Xinjiang Zijin Zinc Industry Co., Ltd. mines zinc, and the Western Gold and Shandong Gold companies produce gold.

Step 8. Answer (Doc 2, Doc 4 and Doc 6): Xinjiang Nonferrous Metals Industry Group, Zijin Mining Group, Baiyin Nonferrous Group and Xinjiang Baiyin Mining Development, in any order.
sections.targeted failure modes:
### Failure mode 1
Trap: Out-of-range period
How a careless solver fails: Uses the wrong period or date

Why these are traps: Out-of-range period: Doc 4 lists Xinjiang Habahe Ashele Copper among January 2025 sourcing-list additions and describes copper mining, so careless solvers add it as a fifth name. Doc 2's November 25, 2024 section (ii) list already includes Ashele, outside that update's five additions, so it joined earlier.
